title: Free Domain with a Web Hosting Plan — Domain Registrations Terms
content:
## Bundle benefit terms — the free domain that comes with a Web Hosting Plans plan (Domain Registrations)

**B1. The benefit.** A customer whose hosting plan includes a free domain under the hosting charter may register one domain free for the TLD's free-with-hosting years against that plan, provided the TLD may be taken as the bundled free domain.

**B2. Plan must be live.** The free registration may be applied only while the hosting plan named on the registration as its bundling plan has status provisioning or active.

**B3. One per plan, for life.** Each hosting plan covers at most one free registration in its lifetime. A plan that already has a domain holding pointing to it as its bundling plan cannot cover another, even if that domain was later deleted or transferred out, while a cancelled registration does not use up the entitlement.

**B4. Later years and transfers.** Renewals of a bundled domain are billed at the normal renewal price, and inbound transfers never qualify.

**B5. Money-back refund of the hosting plan.** If the hosting plan is refunded under its money-back guarantee while the customer keeps the domain, the TLD's bundle registration value for the domain is deducted from that hosting refund as the hosting charter states, and the domain registration itself is never refunded on that account.

### Basis

B2 rests on the system record of the hosting plan named as the bundling plan (its status). B3 rests on the domain holdings that name that plan as their bundling plan, whatever their status — pending, active, on hold, grace, redemption, pending delete, deleted or transferred out — a cancelled holding being the only one that leaves the entitlement unused.

### Earlier holdings against the same plan — decision table

| Earlier holding naming the plan | Plan can cover a new free registration |
|---|---|
| none | yes |
| cancelled only | yes |
| deleted | no |
| transferred out | no |
| active, on hold, grace, redemption, pending delete or pending | no |

### Points of judgement

- *The bundled domain was deleted and the customer wants another free domain on the same plan.* The plan already has a holding pointing to it, so it cannot cover another.
- *Does an inbound transfer use the free domain?* No; inbound transfers never qualify.
